mapper.sql: SELECT profile_id, employee_id, employee_no, employee_name, user_id, sales_region, channel_name, sales_level, commission_plan_id, entry_target, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_hr_sales_profile
mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%') AND employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeNo}, '%') AND sales_region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{salesRegion}, '%') AND channel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{channelName}, '%') AND sales_level = #{salesLevel}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_sales_profile (employee_id, employee_no, employee_name, user_id, sales_region, channel_name, sales_level, commission_plan_id, entry_target, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{employeeNo}, #{employeeName}, #{userId}, #{salesRegion}, #{channelName}, #{salesLevel}, #{commissionPlanId}, #{entryTarget}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_sales_profile employee_no = #{employeeNo}, employee_name = #{employeeName}, user_id = #{userId}, sales_region = #{salesRegion}, channel_name = #{channelName}, sales_level = #{salesLevel}, commission_plan_id = #{commissionPlanId}, entry_target = #{entryTarget}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_sales_profile SET del_flag = '2' WHERE profile_id IN #{profileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_perf_manual (period, employee_id, employee_name, manual_amount, manual_reason, perf_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{period}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{manualAmount}, #{manualReason}, '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_perf_manual manual_amount = #{manualAmount}, manual_reason = #{manualReason}, perf_status = #{perfStatus}, approver = #{approver}, approve_time = #{approveTime}, approve_opinion = #{approveOpinion}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE manual_id = #{manualId}
mapper.sql: SELECT perf_id, period, employee_id, employee_name, user_id, deal_amount, payment_amount, new_customer_count, manual_amount, total_amount, agg_time, del_flag, remark FROM biz_hr_perf_month
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND period = #{period} ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_perf_month (period, employee_id, employee_name, user_id, deal_amount, payment_amount, new_customer_count, manual_amount, total_amount, agg_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{period}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{userId}, #{dealAmount}, #{paymentAmount}, #{newCustomerCount}, #{manualAmount}, #{totalAmount}, sysdate(), '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_perf_month deal_amount = #{dealAmount}, payment_amount = #{paymentAmount}, new_customer_count = #{newCustomerCount}, manual_amount = #{manualAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(),
WHERE perf_id = #{perfId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_perf_month SET del_flag = '2' WHERE period = #{period}
mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id AS userId, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM mk_order o JOIN mk_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period} GROUP BY c.user_id

SELECT c.user_id AS userId, SUM(p.this_amount) AS amount FROM mk_payment_record p JOIN mk_customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period} GROUP BY c.user_id

SELECT c.user_id AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS amount FROM mk_customer c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{period} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mk_order o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.del_flag = '0') GROUP BY c.user_id

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, SUM(m.manual_amount) AS amount FROM biz_hr_perf_manual m JOIN biz_hr_sales_profile p ON m.employee_id = p.employee_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user e ON p.user_id = e.user_id WHERE m.del_flag = '0' AND m.perf_status = '1' AND m.period = #{period} AND p.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.user_id
